wrong_findings.why_wrong: The title is 88 characters (crawl.csv Title 1 Length = 88). The issue is real, but the number is wrong.

wrong_findings.claim: Google now shows FAQ rich results only for a few types of site
wrong_findings.why_wrong: Outdated: Google stopped showing FAQ rich results in May 2026, so they no longer show for any site.

notes: All 20 planted issues found with a specific page and correct fix advice. The only false claims are a wrong title length (83 vs 88) and an outdated statement about FAQ rich results. No GEO advice or promo additions. The Python 404 page claim could not be checked from the static files and was not counted.
